5 تطلّس It (a writing) became obliterated, or effaced. (S.) [See also 7.] ＝
-A2- تطلّس بِطَيْلَسَانٍ, and ↓ تَطَيْلَسَ , He clad, or attired, himself with a طَيْلَسَان. (M, TA.) [The former verb is used by El-Hemedhánee transitively, as meaning, He put on, or made use of, a napkin as a طيلسان: (see De Sacy's Chrest. Arabe, sec. ed., vol. iii., p. 90 of the Arabic text:) but perhaps this usage is only post-classical.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
